summary: Record an automation install in the active project AND return the exact args (taskId, prompt, description, cronExpression) for Cowork's create_scheduled_task. Fluxito does NOT schedule anything itself.

params.name: channel_label
params.doc: Free-text destination ('Slack #growth' / 'alerts@acme.com'); substituted into the prompt as channel_label. Required.

params.name: variables
params.doc: Override values merged over the automation's default variable values.

params.name: cron_expression
params.doc: Override; falls back to automation.default_cron, then '0 9 * * *'.

params.name: task_name
params.doc: Human task label; falls back to default_task_name, then '<title> — <project>'.

returns: { success:true, automation:{slug,title,theme}, installation_id|null, next_step, scheduled_task_args:{taskId,prompt,description,cronExpression}, task_label, schedule_label, channel_label, manage_url } | {error,error_type,message,...}

summary: Author a custom (user-type) automation recipe scoped to the active project; always min_tier='pro', is_featured=False. Becomes installable via action='install'.

params.name: prompt_template
params.example: Check {{project_name}} revenue and alert {{channel_label}} if it drops >20%.
params.doc: Prompt body with {{project_name}}/{{channel_label}} placeholders for install-time substitution. Required.

params.name: required_platforms
params.doc: Array of platform keys; stored as [] if omitted.

params.name: channel_hints
params.doc: Array of strings used by the install UI; stored as [] if omitted.

params.name: cooldown_hours
params.doc: Min hours between runs; stored as 0 if falsy.

params.name: variables
params.doc: Variable-definition dicts (array of objects). NOTE: automation_action reuses the single 'variables' param for BOTH install (dict overrides) and save (list of defs).

returns: { success:true, automation_id, slug, title, theme, view_url, note } | {error,error_type,message}
